value.title: Harness Engineering 入门：定义、组成与定位
value.summary: 理解 Harness Engineering 作为模型之外运行框架工程的定义、核心组成及其在 AI 工程演进中的定位。

questions.stem: 根据资料，Harness Engineering 主要关注的是哪一层？

options.text: 模型内部的参数与训练算法
围绕 AI 模型的非模型层，即智能体运行框架
仅用于编写提示词的技巧集合
数据库与向量检索的底层存储引擎

questions.explanation: 资料指出 Harness Engineering 是设计模型之外的非模型层，这一层称为 agent harness，使模型能使用工具、遵循指令并在运行时达成目标。

questions.stem: 资料中提到的核心公式“Agent 等于什么”是哪一项？

options.text: Agent = Prompt + Context
Agent = Model + Harness
Agent = Model + Dataset
Agent = Harness + Sandbox

questions.explanation: 资料明确给出该领域已形成的核心公式：Agent 等于 Model 加 Harness，模型提供推理能力，harness 提供工具、记忆、校验与安全护栏。

questions.stem: 按照资料对 AI 工程成熟阶段的描述，Harness Engineering 处于哪个位置？

options.text: 第一阶段，早于提示工程
第二阶段，与上下文工程并列
第三阶段，继提示工程和上下文工程之后

evidence.quote: Harness engineering, a subset of [AI engineering](https://www.snowflake.com/en/artificial-intelligence/ai-engineering/), is the discipline of designing the non-model layer around an AI model so it can use tools, follow task-specific instructions, operate within a runtime and achieve a defined outcome more reliably. This layer is called the agent harness.
The core formula the field has settled on is simple: Agent equals Model plus Harness.

harness engineering is best understood as the third phase of AI engineering maturity, following prompt engineering and context engineering, and it sits closer to systems engineering and DevOps than to machine learning research.
Harness engineering is the newest stage in a broader shift in how developers work with AI systems.
A reliable AI agent depends on the runtime around it: the tools it can call, the context it receives, the state it remembers and the guardrails it follows.
the harness supplies the tool access, memory, verification checks, and safety guardrails
Harness engineering | Designing the full system around the model — tools, sandboxes, loops, guardrails
Prompt and context engineering both live inside harness engineering. The harness is the system around the model; prompts and context are pieces of that system.

sources.title: Harness Engineering for Reliable AI Agents | Snowflake
sources.excerpt:
A reliable AI agent depends on the runtime around it: the tools it can call, the context it receives, the state it remembers and the guardrails it follows. Harness engineering brings those pieces together so teams can build agents that handle multistep work safely and consistently.
…
Harness engineering is the process of building the systems around an AI model so it can do useful work. The model provides the intelligence, while the harness gives it the tools, context, structure and safeguards it needs to apply that intelligence effectively.
…
Harness engineering, a subset of [AI engineering](https://www.snowflake.com/en/artificial-intelligence/ai-engineering/), is the discipline of designing the non-model layer around an AI model so it can use tools, follow task-specific instructions, operate within a runtime and achieve a defined outcome more reliably. This layer is called the agent harness.
…
This is where harness engineering intersects with context engineering. Context engineering is the discipline of choosing, structuring and delivering the right information to the model. The harness runs that strategy inside the agent loop — deciding when to retrieve context, how much to include and how to prioritize competing inputs while staying within the model’s context window.

It’s a discipline focused on structuring and coordinating AI coding agent sessions so they produce consistent, repeatable results — not just one-off outputs. The core formula the field has settled on is simple: Agent equals Model plus Harness. The model supplies raw reasoning ability, while the harness supplies the tool access, memory, verification checks, and safety guardrails
